LanguageData.FG.PixieFlightDesc: While active, gain flight, speed and psychic prowess.
LanguageData.FG.PixieAutoModeAlways: always, while awake, even when hungry or tired
LanguageData.FG.PixieAutoModeAlwaysLand: always, while awake; the wings fold when food or rest runs low and come out again once both recover
LanguageData.FG.PixieNeedsLow: {PAWN_nameDef} is too tired or too hungry to fly. Food and sleep will bring the wings back.
LanguageData.FG.PixieWeaponRestricted: {PAWN_nameDef} is too small for anything but a wand or a pistol.
LanguageData.FG.PixieWingStaminaDesc: How long {PAWN_nameDef}'s wings can carry {PAWN_objective}. Flying wears on {PAWN_possessive} food and rest; when either runs low, the wings fold. Food and sleep bring them back.
